line: Crowley's Two of Cups is the card for the first decan of Cancer, with Venus as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Cancer.

quotes.quote: The Two of Cups is the Lord of Love
The card also refers to Venus in Cancer.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: It shows the harmony of the male and the female: interpreted in the largest sense.
